## Final Report

**Gap closed:** GP-20 (Loop Prevention) in `ai-os/CONSTITUTION.yaml`.

**What was built:**
- `wouldCreateCycle()` — pure DFS reachability check (`src/lib/loop-prevention.ts`), unit-tested directly (2-task cycle, 3-task cycle, longer non-cyclic chains, independent chains, diamond dependency, self-loop, determinism).
- `recordTaskEscalationEdge()` — DB-touching wrapper (new `src/lib/task-dependency-graph.ts`), storing edges in the existing `entity_relationships` graph table (no new table/migration), refusing via `ServiceError` (409, `TASK_ESCALATION_CYCLE`) before an edge would close a cycle.
- Wired into `crm-service.ts`'s `createChainedTask()` — confirmed by reading `task-execution-engine.ts`'s full dispatch/escalation call chain that this is the **one real call site** where one task spawns and executes a second, distinct task record (all other escalation there is same-task, role-ladder only, structurally acyclic).
- Honestly documented in CONSTITUTION.yaml that this one live caller always inserts a fresh task as its target, so it can't itself hit the cycle-refusal branch today — the check is real and general-purpose for the next dispatch surface that can target an existing task.

**Verification:** `bunx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run lint` 0 errors, `bun test` 1741 pass/0 fail, all 6 local CI guardrail scripts pass.
